proof_run.source_identity: All8 source/test Git blob SHA1 values verified against exact GitHub fetch result after byte-preserving write.
proof_run.claim_boundary: Pure synthetic read-only oracle execution only. No Node22, full image, hosted events, provider, customer, restart or rollback was executed. PR399/400 former V8-only evidence now has actual Node24 execution, not a release gate.

northstar.action: Do not substitute same-name project for pinned canonical standalone Northstar until identity is authoritatively reconciled.

model_policy.routine: Use lowest-cost available model that reliably resolves source/status and formatting; escalate uncertainty rather than guessing.
model_policy.engineering: Use efficient Codex/Sol model with exact source/tests; batch independent deterministic checks.
model_policy.security_review: Independent verifier separate from author; higher reasoning for authority/concurrency/tenant/payroll/rollback. Astra only if a concrete hard issue cannot be resolved efficiently.
model_policy.activation: No external cloud model selection or paid compute was activated by this audit; this session agent uses inherited model.
